verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no OpenCode statement, setting, or policy about whether user data is used for AI model training, and no training opt-out. Support for local models and routing through an internal enterprise AI gateway are related controls that let a user keep data away from providers, but they are not a documented training-data guarantee. The community telemetry complaint concerns telemetry collection, not training use, so it does not establish either support or a dispute.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
